# build a battery of candidates
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
os.makedirs('cands', exist_ok=True)
cands = {
 'empty': b'',
 'b64_ff': b'\xff'*64,
 'b64_00': b'\x00'*64,
 'b63_ff': b'\xff'*63,
 'b65_ff': b'\xff'*65,
 'b1000_ff': b'\xff'*1000,
 'b64_mix': bytes(range(64)),
 'b64_rand': os.urandom(64),
}
for k,v in cands.items():
    open('cands/'+k,'wb').write(v)
print('candidates:', list(cands))
EOF
for f in cands/*; do ./vuln "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; V=$?; ./fixed "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; F=$?; echo "$f vuln=$V fixed=$F"; done"}
